title: Corridor Agreement expires with no renewal

facts.subject: Corridor Agreement
facts.statement: The Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026.

facts.subject: Corridor Agreement Renewal
facts.statement: Talks on renewal ended without agreement.

source_ref.text_snippet: Talks on renewal ended without agreement.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: From the day after expiry, wheat and maize leaving Orvan Grain Port by sea move under the general export rules.

source_ref.text_snippet: From the day after expiry, wheat and maize leaving Orvan Grain Port by sea move under the general export rules.

facts.subject: Export Rules
facts.statement: The notice does not create a grace period and does not reopen the agreement.

source_ref.text_snippet: The notice does not create a grace period and does not reopen the agreement.

facts.subject: Future Notices
facts.statement: A further notice will follow if the position changes.

source_ref.text_snippet: A further notice will follow if the position changes.
